response.original_title: Disney Adventure: Charting a New Course
response.overview: Go behind the scenes with National Geographic to explore the massive engineering and creative journey of building Disney Cruise Line's largest ship to date, the Disney Adventure. From its initial rescue as a partially constructed vessel to its transformation into a floating Disney wonderland, this special documents the innovative design, construction challenges, and unparalleled scale required to bring this new class of ship to life.
